reviews.body: **Devin Review** found 5 potential issues.

**Devin Review** found 1 new potential issue.
🐛 1 issue in files not directly in the diff ### 🐛 DeepCLI text interface no longer starts because unfinished merge leftovers were committed into it ([`deepcli-tui/tui.py:273-328`](https://github.com/timerloggedout-spec/termux-monorepo/blob/5fecc3b48d63e5f35c177fc8c25df7c5b43a594e/deepcli-tui/tui.py#L273-L328)) The DeepCLI TUI program file keeps raw merge leftover markers (`<<<<<<< HEAD` at `deepcli-tui/tui.py:273`) instead of a single resolved version of the commands screen, so the whole tool refuses to run. Impact: Anyone launching the DeepCLI text interface gets an immediate failure rather than a working session, and the repository hygiene gate fails.
Merge conflict markers left inside show_commands() make the module unparsable The merge commit adopting the "master-staging spine" committed unresolved conflict markers at `deepcli-tui/tui.py:273`, `deepcli-tui/tui.py:306`, and `deepcli-tui/tui.py:328`, keeping both variants of `show_commands()`. Python cannot parse `<<<<<<< HEAD` / `=======` / `>>>>>>> master-staging`, so importing or executing `tui.py` raises a SyntaxError at load time — the entire TUI, not just the help screen, is dead. `scripts/ci/repo_gate.py:222` (`check_python_syntax`) compiles changed Python files from the index and will HARD-fail on this file. The duplicated `input("\nPress Enter to continue...")` (once inside the HEAD side, once after the end marker) shows only one branch was intended to survive.
